description: This file is a header file declaring classes and methods related to merging module representations in a linker tool, including MergeStatus and ModuleMerger classes which handle various aspects of merging module IRs and types.

classes.name: MergeStatus
classes.description: Represents the merge status of a particular type or module element, indicating if it was newly added and its type identifier.

classes.name: ModuleMerger
classes.description: Handles merging of module IRs, including merging graphs, types, functions, and dependencies within a linker context.

methods.name: const repr::ModuleIR & GetModule()
methods.description: Returns a reference to the internal ModuleIR object managed by ModuleMerger.

methods.name: MergeGraphs
methods.description: Merges another ModuleIR into the current module, combining their contents.

methods.name: MergeCFunctionLikeDeps
methods.description: Merges dependencies related to C-style function-like IR elements.

methods.name: MergeFunctionType
methods.description: Merges function type IR elements from the addend into the current module.

methods.name: MergeEnumType
methods.description: Merges enum type IR elements from the addend.

methods.name: MergeEnumDependencies
methods.description: Merges enum dependencies associated with a specific enum IR node.

methods.name: MergeRecordAndDependencies
methods.description: Merges a record type IR node along with its dependencies.

methods.name: MergeRecordDependencies
methods.description: Merges dependencies related to a record type IR.

methods.name: MergeRecordFields
methods.description: Merges fields within a record IR.

methods.name: MergeRecordCXXBases
methods.description: Merges C++ base class dependencies in a record IR.

methods.name: MergeRecordTemplateElements
methods.description: Merges template elements of a record IR.

methods.name: MergeGlobalVariable
methods.description: Merges a global variable IR node.

methods.name: MergeGlobalVariables
methods.description: Handles merging of multiple global variables from the addend module.

methods.name: MergeFunctionDeps
methods.description: Merges dependencies for a function IR node.

methods.name: MergeFunction
methods.description: Merges a function IR node into the current module.

methods.name: MergeReferencingTypeInternalAndUpdateParent
methods.description: Merges a referencing type, updating parent relationships accordingly.

methods.name: MergeReferencingTypeInternal
methods.description: Merges a referencing type IR element.

methods.name: MergeReferencingType
methods.description: Public interface for merging referencing types.

methods.name: UpdateUDTypeAccounting
methods.description: Updates accounting info for user-defined types during merge.

methods.name: MergeBuiltinType
methods.description: Merges a built-in type IR node.

methods.name: LookupUserDefinedType
methods.description: Finds or adds a user-defined type to the merge context.

methods.name: LookupType
methods.description: Looks up a type IR node within the addend module.

methods.name: MergeTypeInternal
methods.description: Performs internal merging logic for type IR nodes.

methods.name: MergeType
methods.description: Public method to merge a type IR node.
